members.name: value
members.doc: The value reported when this option is chosen.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the wheel shows. Falls back to the value.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Shown dimmed; the wheel never comes to rest on it.

members.name: id
members.doc: Key of this column in the picker's value object, for example "hour".

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the column, for example "Hour".

members.name: options
members.doc: The options from top to bottom.

members.name: suffix
members.doc: Fixed text shown beside the selection band after this column, such as ":" or "min". It does not scroll.

members.name: width
members.doc: Column width in px or any CSS length. By default it fits its widest option.

members.name: align
members.doc: How labels line up inside the column.

types.name: WheelValue
types.doc: One chosen value per column, keyed by column id.

types.name: WheelPickerProps
types.doc: A wheel picker like the one on a phone: drag or flick a column and it coasts, then settles on the nearest option. It also answers the mouse wheel, a click on any option, arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Down, and typing the start of a label. Columns sit side by side behind one selection band, and disabled options are skipped wherever the wheel would stop.

members.name: columns
members.doc: One wheel per entry, left to right.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Values chosen at first (uncontrolled). A column without one starts on its first enabled option.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Runs with every column's value when one settles on a new option; `columnId` says which one moved.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the whole picker, for example "Reminder time".

members.name: itemHeight
members.doc: Height of one row in px.

members.name: visibleCount
members.doc: How many rows show at once. Use an odd number so one row sits in the middle.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the control off: it is dimmed and ignores pointer and keyboard input.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.
